g.text: Membership user IDs are unique within a group.
The owner is always a member and cannot be removed or leave.
without loading User (ADR-0014). The public user ID
is a UserHandle on the profile, outside User (ADR-0021).
Roles authorize actors and run workflows; Session validates and records prepared changes.
Session creation/admission require an active account and a present email, without requiring email confirmation.
Wallet uses committed ledger history; reliability and group IDs are loaded related values.
